admin.geminiApiKeyDescription: Used for AI reply generation and knowledge-base embeddings across every organization. Rotating it here reaches both the API service and the AI worker automatically — no redeploy needed.
admin.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
admin.noOrganizationsDescription: Every organization that signs up will show up here.
admin.pageDescription: Platform-wide view across every organization. Visible to ReplyPilot staff only.
admin.reactivateDescription: Restores login access for this organization.
admin.realKeyHint: Real Gemini keys start with "AIzaSy" — double-check before saving.
admin.suspendDescription: Blocks login for every member of this organization, starting at their next login or token refresh. This does not cancel their Stripe subscription — handle billing separately if needed.

aiInbox.nothingWaitingDescription: The AI is confidently handling every open conversation right now — low-confidence handoffs will show up here.
aiInbox.pageDescription: The AI already replied to these, but flagged its own answer as low-confidence — worth a quick review. Take one over to reply yourself.

analytics.aiInsightsEmpty: No AI insights yet — click Generate to get a summary of sales, leads, and what customers seem to think of you.
analytics.aiInsightsError: Couldn't generate insights. Please try again.
analytics.pageDescription: Response time, AI reply volume, and conversation outcomes over the trailing 14 days.

auth.accountNotFound: No account found with that email.
auth.codeInvalid: That code is invalid or has expired.
auth.createAccountDescription: Sets up a new workspace and makes you its Owner.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.noWorkspace: This account has no active workspace to log into.
auth.passwordUpdatedDescription: Your password has been reset. You can now log in with your new password.
auth.resetPasswordDescription: Enter your email and we'll send you a 6-digit code to reset your password.
auth.setNewPasswordDescription: Choose a new password for your account.
auth.slugTaken: That workspace URL is taken — try a different one.

billing.couldntOpenPortal: Couldn't open the billing portal. Please try again.
billing.couldntStartCheckout: Couldn't start checkout. Please try again.
billing.noActivePlanDescription: Choose a plan to get started — the AI reply pipeline, knowledge base, and team features all require an active subscription.
billing.plansPageDescription: Pick the plan that fits — you can change or cancel anytime from the billing portal.

click.connectDescription: Enter your Click merchant/kassa ID so ReplyPilot can send customers a ready-to-pay link when they ask to buy something, and confirm the payment automatically once it's paid. You'll need the merchant_id, service_id, and secret key from your Click Merchant Cabinet — the secret key is required so ReplyPilot can verify Click's payment confirmation.
click.connectedHint: The AI sends this payment link to customers when they ask to buy a product from the catalog. Once Click confirms the payment, the customer gets a thank-you message and this conversation gets a note showing exactly what was paid for.
click.disconnectDescription: The AI immediately stops sending payment links to customers. This only removes the stored merchant_id/service_id — nothing changes on Click's side.
click.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
click.merchantUserIdHint: Optional — only needed if your Click setup requires a specific merchant user.
click.secretKeyHint: From your Click Merchant Cabinet, next to merchant_id/service_id. Encrypted at rest, never shown again after saving.

commentAutomation.description: When someone comments on one of your Instagram posts, the AI sends them a DM and handles the conversation from there. Instagram allows one automatic DM per comment.
commentAutomation.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
commentAutomation.publicReplyHint: Optional. Posted publicly under the comment, exactly as written — the AI never changes it. Leave empty to only send the DM.

conversations.aiSummaryEmpty: No summary yet — click Generate to have AI summarize what this customer discussed.
conversations.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
conversations.noConversationsDescription: New Instagram DMs will show up here as soon as a connected account receives one.
conversations.noMessagesDescription: This thread hasn't received anything yet.
conversations.noSearchResultsDescription: Try a different username, or clear the search.
conversations.pageDescription: Every DM thread across your connected accounts.

dashboard.noAiActivityDescription: This project's AI reply pipeline hasn't been built yet — there's nothing in ai_responses to report on. This card will populate automatically once it exists.
dashboard.noConversationsDescription: New Instagram DMs will show up here as soon as a connected account receives one.
dashboard.notEnoughResponseData: Not enough data yet — needs at least one conversation with both an inbound message and a reply in the last 30 days.
dashboard.pageDescription: Live from your connected Instagram accounts and conversations.

errors.pageNotFoundDescription: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

instagram.accountConnectedHint: ReplyPilot can now read and reply to this account's DMs.
instagram.accountStatusHintConnected: Active — receiving and replying to DMs.
instagram.accountStatusHintError: Something went wrong with this connection. Reconnect to resume replies.
instagram.accountStatusHintExpired: Access token expired. Reconnect to resume replies.
instagram.accountStatusHintRevoked: Access was revoked from Instagram's side. Reconnect to resume replies.
instagram.couldntStartConnect: Couldn't start the connect flow. Please try again.
instagram.disconnectDescription: ReplyPilot stops replying to this account's DMs immediately. This only removes ReplyPilot's stored access — to fully revoke it, also remove ReplyPilot from Instagram's own "Apps and websites" settings.
instagram.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
instagram.noAccountConnectedDescription: Connect your Instagram Business account so ReplyPilot can read and reply to your DMs.
instagram.pageDescription: Connect your Instagram Business account so ReplyPilot can read and reply to DMs on your behalf.

knowledgeBase.contentPlaceholder: Paste the text you want the AI to be able to answer from…
knowledgeBase.deleteDocumentDescription: Removes the document and every chunk/embedding derived from it. The AI stops drawing on it immediately. This can't be undone.
knowledgeBase.editDocumentDescription: Editing the text re-chunks and re-embeds the whole document — the AI's answers reflect the new version once this saves.
knowledgeBase.fileHint: .txt or .md only — PDF/DOCX parsing isn't implemented yet.
knowledgeBase.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
knowledgeBase.noDocumentsDescription: Upload a document to start grounding the AI's replies in your own content.
knowledgeBase.pageDescription: The documents the AI is grounded to — it answers from these only.
knowledgeBase.title: Title
knowledgeBase.uploadPageDescription: Ingested synchronously — chunked and embedded via Gemini before this returns, so it can take a moment for a large document.

leads.noLeadsDescription: When a customer leaves a phone number in a DM, it shows up here for someone to call back.
leads.pageDescription: Customers who left a phone number — call them back.

products.deleteProductDescription: Removes the product for good. Existing conversations that already mention it aren't affected.
products.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
products.name: Name
products.noProductsDescription: Add a product so the AI can quote an exact price — and, once Click is connected, send a ready-to-pay link — when a customer asks to buy.
products.pageDescription: Products the AI can quote exact prices for, with payment links once Click is connected.
products.productFormDescription: The AI only quotes prices and sends payment links for active products listed here.

profile.emailChangeHint: Email can't be changed here — this account has no re-verification flow for a new address yet.
profile.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
profile.pageDescription: Your personal account details and password.

settings.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
settings.pageDescription: Organization name and timezone — Instagram connections have their own page, AI behavior tuning isn't configurable yet.
settings.slugHint: The slug isn't editable here — it's embedded in the Instagram connection flow and any links already shared.

team.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
team.inviteMemberDescription: They need an existing ReplyPilot account — ask them to sign up first if they don't have one yet.
team.noMembersDescription: Invite someone to start collaborating on this workspace.
team.pageDescription: Who has access to this workspace.
team.removeMemberDescription: They lose access to this organization immediately. This can't be undone from here — they'd need to be re-invited.

telegram.awaitingPairingHint: The bot is connected, but you still need to pair it inside your own Telegram app: open Telegram → Settings → Telegram Business → Chatbots, and add this bot. Messages won't arrive here until that's done.
telegram.connectDescription: Create a bot with @BotFather on Telegram, then paste its token here. After connecting, open your own Telegram app's Settings → Telegram Business → Chatbots and add this bot to finish pairing — that's a Telegram Premium feature and happens on Telegram's side, not here.
telegram.connectedHint: The AI replies to messages sent to your connected Telegram account the same way it replies to Instagram DMs.
telegram.disconnectDescription: The AI immediately stops replying on Telegram. This only removes the stored bot token — nothing changes on Telegram's or BotFather's side.
telegram.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

validation.apiKeyInvalid: Doesn't look like a real API key
validation.contentTooLong: That's too long for one document
validation.passwordMaxLength72: Password must be at most 72 characters
validation.passwordMinLength8: Password must be at least 8 characters
